text: In nineteen forty five, a chicken lost his head and lived eighteen more months. Farmer Lloyd Olsen of Colorado chopped it off. The axe missed part of the brain stem, and one ear. Mike kept walking, and the Olsens fed him with an eyedropper. Scientists studied him, and he toured as a sideshow star. He died in nineteen forty seven, after choking. Today, the town of Fruita still holds a festival for him. Would you have named him Mike?
